subject: Expansion: Pegasus Labs — add three project teams & keys (term amendment request)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@pegasuslabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@pegasuslabs.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion request — 3 new projects + keys (renewal window)

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our side: Pegasus is ramping two new internal products (Pegasus Search and Workflow Engine) plus a small R&D sandbox team that will be customer-facing in Q1. We want to add 3 project-level API keys and a rollout plan so teams can go from staging to prod within 3–4 weeks.

Current contract covers a single account-level commitment and we're approaching renewal next month. Before the renewal, we need to confirm:
- Can we provision 3 additional project keys tied to the same account?
- Any changes needed to commits or rates for expected traffic (roughly 1.2M tokens/month shared across new projects, peaking at 8 QPS during daytime)?
- Suggested rollout schedule and who at Redwood will own the enablement?

I've attached a quick CSV with team names and expected start dates (pegasus_project_list.csv).

Would love a short call this week to align.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan | Head of Platform, Pegasus Labs
Attachments: pegasus_project_list.csv (CSV)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pegasuslabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new projects + keys (renewal window)

Samira — thanks for the details and the CSV. We're excited to support Pegasus on this. Quick answers up front: yes, we can provision project-level keys under the same tenant; we typically issue one key per project with RBAC and per-key usage dashboards.

Before we lock a rollout plan I need a couple of specifics so we size capacity appropriately:
- Expected average QPS per project and burst behavior (you mentioned 8 QPS peak, is that per-project or aggregate?)
- Any low-latency SLOs for specific endpoints (e.g., sub-200ms tail)?

I'll loop in Monica from Customer Success to propose a staged rollout / enablement plan and Aditya from Solutions for integration assistance. If you can share a short call window, we'll align on timeline and a potential amendment to the renewal that captures the additional commit needed.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pegasuslabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new projects + keys (proposed rollout & capacity)

Hi Samira — jumping in with a proposed rollout + capacity plan based on the CSV. Attaching our MAP (Pegasus-MAP-v2.pdf) that summarizes phases and recommended commit adjustments.

Proposed approach (3 phases):
1) Staging enablement (Week 1): issue 3 project keys, set up RBAC, create per-key dashboards and alerting. Integration support from Aditya (2 1-hr sessions).
2) Controlled prod ramp (Weeks 2–3): move one project to prod, monitor token consumption and latencies, enable KV-prefix caching for repeat workloads.
3) Full prod activation (Week 4): enable remaining projects, enable autoscale policy (burst to Dedicated pool if needed).

Capacity and economics notes:
- Based on your peak 8 QPS aggregate, we recommend a small Dedicated burst buffer (equivalent to ~0.5 GPU persistent capacity) for the first 6 weeks of ramp.
- Suggested short-term commit adjustment: +30% monthly token commit for the first 3 months (covers ramp and reduces per-token rate).
- One-time onboarding credit: we can offer a $6k onboarding credit if Pegasus agrees to a 12‑month renewal amendment that formalizes the added commit.

Attachments: Pegasus-MAP-v2.pdf (1 page — phased plan + timing)

Ask: can you confirm whether the 8 QPS is aggregate or per-project and whether the sandbox team needs a lower latency tier? We'll prepare a SOW draft once those details are confirmed.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@pegasuslabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@pegasuslabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new projects + keys (proposed rollout & capacity)

Thanks Monica — the MAP is helpful. To clarify: the 8 QPS is aggregate expected peak across the three new projects during daytime. Typical daily profile is 08:00–20:00 PST higher load; sandbox will be very low priority and can use the base hosted tier.

Question on the commercials: the onboarding credit looks good. A few asks from procurement:
- Can we get the 12‑month amendment aligned to our renewal date (Dec 15)?
- If actual usage stays below the adjusted commit in months 2–3, can unused commit roll forward as credit?

We can do a 30-minute sync Wed 11/11 at 10:00 PST if that works for your team.

Best,
Samira
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pegasuslabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, legal_team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new projects + keys (procurement & amendment)

Samira — the 10:00 PST slot works for us; I’ve booked it. Karthik (cc) will confirm the commercial uplift and final credit mechanics; Legal is on copy to prep an amendment tied to your Dec 15 renewal date.

Next steps for the call (Wed 11/11, 10:00 PST):
- Agree on the +30% short-term commit and onboarding credit terms.
- Confirm roll-forward policy for unused commit (we typically allow a limited roll-forward window; Karthik will confirm).
- Agree SOW items and who signs (we’ll send an SOW draft to speed execution).

Aditya — please have a short checklist for the integration sessions (SDK keys, RBAC, dashboards) ready for the call.

See you at 10.

—Vivek
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pegasuslabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, legal_team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request — commercial terms & SOW draft

Samira — following our call, we’re aligned to the +30% short-term commit for months 1–3 and a one-time $6k onboarding credit contingent on a 12-month renewal amendment signed by Dec 15. For roll-forward of unused commit: Redwood allows up to 25% of monthly unused tokens to carry forward for a maximum of one month (we can include this in the amendment).

I’ve asked Legal to prepare an amendment and a short SOW (SOW-draft-pegasus.docx) that lists the three new projects, per-key RBAC details, and the staged enablement timeline. Expect the draft in your inbox by EOD tomorrow.

If that sounds right, we’ll queue the amendment and engineering enablement calendar.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW-draft-pegasus.docx (Word doc)
